source: Round 15: every named failure and refusal in this codebase, classified once, in data — the GateError codes the shell raises, the tool port's refusal codes, and the failure classes the stored records carry.

classes.label: Model serving
classes.summary: The model endpoint or the profile serving the work failed, or cannot serve here.

classes.label: Plan
classes.summary: A plan draft's shape, or the binding between an approved plan and the repo it was approved against.

classes.label: Sandbox and tools
classes.summary: A tool call inside the sandbox refused or reported failure, as data the model acts on.

classes.label: Verification
classes.summary: The shell's verdict on the patch, computed on the pristine copy.

classes.label: Budgets
classes.summary: A governed spend ceiling — per run, or per batch — was reached.

classes.label: Gate refusals
classes.summary: A governed act was refused by a rule: a gate, a separation of duties, a validation, a name the shell has no record of.

classes.label: Run lifecycle
classes.summary: The run's own landing — failed or interrupted — with the specific reason carried in the record's detail.

classes.label: Store and infrastructure
classes.summary: The deployment's own ground moved: files the records point at are gone, the process died, or the configuration does not load.

entries.name: model_auth_failed
entries.cause: The endpoint rejected the deployment's API key (401).
entries.action: Check the key in the environment for the serving profile; rotate it if it was revoked.

entries.name: model_unknown_slug
entries.cause: The profile's model slug is not served by the endpoint (404).
entries.action: Compare the slug against the provider's current catalog and refresh the profile record.

entries.name: model_rate_limited
entries.cause: The provider stayed rate-limited (429) through the adapter's bounded retries.
entries.action: Wait for the provider's window to pass, then resume or restart the interrupted run; consider a higher tier if it recurs.

entries.name: model_overloaded
entries.cause: The provider stayed overloaded (529) through the adapter's bounded retries.
entries.action: Wait and resume the interrupted run; if it persists, check the provider's status page.

entries.name: model_server_error
entries.cause: The provider returned server errors (5xx) through the adapter's bounded retries.
entries.action: Wait and resume the interrupted run; report it to the provider if it persists.

entries.name: model_unreachable
entries.cause: The endpoint could not be reached at all (DNS, TLS, or timeout) through the bounded retries.
entries.action: Check network egress and the endpoint URL, then resume the interrupted run.

entries.name: model_request_rejected
entries.cause: The endpoint rejected the request itself — a non-retryable 4xx other than auth or an unknown slug.
entries.action: Read the refusal's message: fix the profile's request shape or slug before running again.

entries.name: model_response_invalid
entries.cause: The endpoint answered with a body the adapter cannot read as a chat completion.
entries.action: Check the endpoint really is the chat-completions API the profile names; capture the body before retrying.

entries.name: model_output_truncated
entries.cause: The reply hit the profile's recorded max_tokens ceiling with nothing usable — the model spent the budget reasoning.
entries.action: Raise the profile's recorded max_tokens ceiling, or pick a less reasoning-heavy model for this work.

entries.name: profile_not_servable
entries.cause: The named profile cannot serve in this deployment — recorded not servable, or its key env is not set.
entries.action: Read the reason on the refusal: set the named key env, or choose a servable profile.

entries.name: not_servable
entries.cause: A benchmark or comparison recorded this profile as unable to serve here, with its reason.
entries.action: Treat it as unmeasured, not failed: fix the named cause (usually the missing key) and re-run the measurement.

entries.name: malformed_plan
entries.cause: A plan draft failed the shared validator — missing approach or steps, a step without intent or files, a file outside the order's scope, or a test that does not resolve.
entries.action: Read the refusal's message for the exact defect; a live model that keeps producing it needs its drafting context or profile revisited.

entries.name: stale_plan
entries.cause: An in-scope file in the target repo changed after the plan was approved, so the approval no longer binds the world as it stands.
entries.action: Draft a fresh plan against the repo as it now stands and have it approved.

entries.name: plan_superseded
entries.cause: The named or implied plan version is not the order's current version — a newer version exists.
entries.action: Act on the current plan version; approvals bind versions, not orders.

entries.name: scope_widening_refused
entries.cause: A plan amendment named files outside the work order's approved scope.
entries.action: Narrow the amendment to the order's scope, or raise a new work order with the wider scope for its own approval.

entries.name: anchor_not_found
entries.cause: An edit's anchor text occurs nowhere in the file.
entries.action: No operator action — the model re-reads and narrows. Repeated occurrences suggest the file moved since planning; check for a stale plan.

entries.name: anchor_ambiguous
entries.cause: An edit's anchor text occurs more than once in the file.
entries.action: No operator action — the model narrows its anchor; the refusal is recorded verbatim for the reviewer.

entries.name: binary_file
entries.cause: A read or edit named a file that is not UTF-8 text.
entries.action: No operator action — binary files are outside the agent's hands by design.

entries.name: edit_outside_scope
entries.cause: An edit named a file outside the plan's approved scope.
entries.action: No operator action — the scope held. If it recurs, the plan's scope and the task's real shape disagree, which is a planning conversation.

entries.name: file_not_found
entries.cause: A tool named a path that does not exist in the workspace.
entries.action: No operator action — the model re-lists. If the file should exist, check the target repo's state.

entries.name: invalid_line_range
entries.cause: A read named a malformed line range.
entries.action: No operator action — the model corrects its range.

entries.name: line_range_out_of_bounds
entries.cause: A read named lines beyond the file's end.
entries.action: No operator action — the refusal names the file's true size and the model re-reads.

entries.name: invalid_pattern
entries.cause: A search pattern is not a valid regular expression.
entries.action: No operator action — the model corrects its pattern.

entries.name: search_glob_invalid
entries.cause: A search glob was malformed.
entries.action: No operator action — the model corrects its glob.

entries.name: search_outside_workspace
entries.cause: A search named a path or glob reaching outside the run's workspace.
entries.action: No operator action — the confinement held. Repeated attempts steered by planted repo content are a red-team signal.

entries.name: no_affected_tests
entries.cause: The shell computed an empty affected-test set for the run's edits.
entries.action: No operator action — verification still runs the full grading set; the affected set is quick feedback only.

entries.name: no_test_paths
entries.cause: A run_tests call named no test paths and no affected set applied.
entries.action: No operator action — the model names tests from the plan.

entries.name: not_a_test_file
entries.cause: A run_tests call named a file that is not a test file.
entries.action: No operator action — the only command shape is pytest over named test files.

entries.name: test_timeout
entries.cause: An in-run test invocation exceeded the shell's test timeout.
entries.action: If it recurs on the same set, the target's tests are slow or hung — investigate the repo, not the agent.

entries.name: tests_failed
entries.cause: The model's own in-run test invocation reported failures.
entries.action: No operator action — in-run results are feedback, never the verdict; verification re-grades on a pristine copy.

entries.name: unknown_tool
entries.cause: A step named a tool the port does not carry.
entries.action: No operator action for the scripted model; a live model inventing tools needs its step behaviour reviewed.

entries.name: verification_failed
entries.cause: The patch failed verification on the pristine copy — most often the grading tests still fail there.
entries.action: Read the run's verification record and patch; the fix did not do what the task asked, so send it back or re-plan.

entries.name: hidden_grading_failed
entries.cause: The patch passed the visible grading set but failed the hidden re-grade — the shape of an overfit fix.
entries.action: Treat the fix as not done: the reviewer sees both verdicts on the record; re-plan against the behaviour, not the visible inputs.

entries.name: test_surface_touched
entries.cause: The patch touches test or grading surface files.
entries.action: On a gold task this fails the run by name. On an ad-hoc order, decide at review whether the scope legitimately included tests.

entries.name: unplanned_files
entries.cause: The patch touches files no step of the approved plan named.
entries.action: Scope creep: compare the patch against the plan's steps at review; the excess work was never approved.

entries.name: no_substantive_change
entries.cause: The patch changes only whitespace.
entries.action: Nothing to review — the run produced motion, not a fix; re-plan or abandon.

entries.name: out_of_scope_edit
entries.cause: A run's patch touched files outside the approved scope — a zero-tolerance class, checked from the records even though the tool port makes it unreachable.
entries.action: Stop and investigate how the record came to stand; this class should be structurally impossible.

entries.name: unverified_success
entries.cause: A run stands SUCCEEDED without a passing verification behind it — a zero-tolerance class, checked from the records.
entries.action: Stop and investigate: SUCCEEDED is only ever verification's verdict, so the record itself is the incident.

entries.name: grading_not_fully_run
entries.cause: The grading evidence shows tests skipped, deselected, or not run — a zero exit over tests that did not run is not a pass.
entries.action: Check the grading set and the target for collection interference; conftest, addopts and startup files are set aside and named on the verdict.

entries.name: grading_evidence_missing
entries.cause: The grading run produced no JUnit evidence to read a verdict from.
entries.action: Treat the run as ungraded, not passed; check the grading invocation in the environment.

entries.name: budget_exhausted
entries.cause: A run — or a resume asked against it — crossed a snapshot budget ceiling: model calls, tokens, or active wall seconds.
entries.action: Restart the run to spend a fresh budget snapshot, or raise the policy ceiling if the work genuinely needs it.

entries.name: batch_budget_exhausted
entries.cause: A batch's folded spend reached its batch-level ceiling; unstarted items are marked budget_stopped on the batch record.
entries.action: Raise the batch ceiling and drive again, or cancel the batch — items already started finish through their own gates.

entries.name: run_failed
entries.cause: The run landed FAILED; the record's detail carries the specific reason — a verification reason, or a terminal model failure by code.
entries.action: Read the failure detail on the run record: this class is the bucket, the detail is the diagnosis.

entries.name: run_interrupted
entries.cause: The run landed INTERRUPTED — a transient model failure, a budget stop, or a process death — with its last checkpoint named.
entries.action: Resume it if its basis still checks out, restart it under the same approval, or abandon it as a recorded act.

entries.name: process_lost
entries.cause: The process driving the run died mid-flight; startup reconciliation marked the run INTERRUPTED.
entries.action: Check why the process died, then resume, restart, or abandon the run.

entries.name: target_missing
entries.cause: The work order's target repo is not on disk where its record points.
entries.action: Restore the target repo or recreate the work order; the record names the path it expected.

entries.name: run_workspace_missing
entries.cause: A resume was asked for a run whose workspace no longer exists.
entries.action: Restart the run instead — resume needs the workspace the checkpoint digests describe.

entries.name: config_error
entries.cause: The deployment itself is misconfigured — a profile, price table, taxonomy, or environment value failed its fail-closed load.
entries.action: Fix the named record or variable and restart; the process refuses to start half-configured on purpose.

entries.name: invalid_digest_window
entries.cause: A digest window's timestamps could not be read, or its start stands after its end.
entries.action: Ask for the window with ISO timestamps and the start before the end.

entries.name: batch_already_cancelled
entries.cause: A cancel was asked of a batch that already stands cancelled.
entries.action: Nothing to do — cancellation is a recorded act and the record stands.

entries.name: batch_cancel_reason_required
entries.cause: A batch cancellation arrived without its reason.
entries.action: Re-submit with the reason; the cancellation record is evidence and a silent one would say nothing.

entries.name: batch_cancelled
entries.cause: An act was asked of a batch that stands cancelled.
entries.action: Raise a new batch for the remaining work; a cancelled batch does not reopen.

entries.name: batch_driver_active
entries.cause: A drive was asked while another drive pass stands marked active on the batch.
entries.action: Wait for the active pass, or release the mark with the recorded release act if the driver died.

entries.name: batch_driver_not_active
entries.cause: A driver release was asked of a batch with no active drive mark.
entries.action: Nothing to release — the mark is already clear.

entries.name: batch_driver_release_reason_required
entries.cause: A driver release arrived without its reason.
entries.action: Re-submit with the reason; releasing a dead driver's mark is a governed act.

entries.name: batch_empty
entries.cause: A batch submission named no items.
entries.action: Submit at least one item; an empty batch would create a record that does no work.

entries.name: challenge_already_answered
entries.cause: A disposition was asked of a challenge that already stands answered.
entries.action: Nothing to do — answers are recorded acts and are not rewritten.

entries.name: challenge_not_downgradable
entries.cause: A downgrade was asked of a challenge that does not stand at must_answer.
entries.action: Only a must-answer challenge can be downgraded; advisory challenges never block.

entries.name: challenge_superseded
entries.cause: A disposition was asked of a challenge whose run a newer run superseded.
entries.action: Answer the current run's challenges instead; the superseded record stays as history.

entries.name: changes_note_required
entries.cause: A request-changes review arrived without the reviewer's note.
entries.action: Re-submit with the note — it is the decision's content, and the next plan drafts against it.

entries.name: reject_reason_required
entries.cause: A review rejection arrived without the reviewer's reason.
entries.action: Re-submit with the reason; a rejection closes the order, and the reason is the record of why.

entries.name: invalid_work_order
entries.cause: A work order failed intake: a missing field, a scope or grading path that is not a clean repo-relative path, or an ad-hoc target that is unnamed, relative, missing, or holds the shell's own data.
entries.action: Read the refusal's message for the offending field and resubmit; an ad-hoc order names its repo by absolute path.

entries.name: downgrade_reason_required
entries.cause: A challenge downgrade arrived without its reason.
entries.action: Re-submit with the reason; the challenge's original severity stays on the record either way.

entries.name: evaluation_stale
entries.cause: A promotion was judged against an evaluation whose task-set hash no longer matches the held-out set.
entries.action: Re-run the evaluation against the current set; old results cannot be shopped.

entries.name: invalid_batch
entries.cause: A batch submission failed its shape checks.
entries.action: Read the refusal's message for the malformed field and resubmit.

entries.name: invalid_batch_budget
entries.cause: A batch budget ceiling was not a positive value.
entries.action: Correct the ceiling and resubmit; ceilings are optional but never zero or negative.

entries.name: invalid_batch_item
entries.cause: One item of a batch submission is malformed — and the batch validates whole, so nothing was created.
entries.action: Fix the item the refusal names, by index, and resubmit the batch.

entries.name: invalid_evaluation_runs
entries.cause: A promotion evaluation was asked for a run count outside its recorded bounds.
entries.action: Ask for a count inside the bounds — worst-of-N needs at least one run, and the gate caps how many.

entries.name: no_passing_evaluation
entries.cause: A promotion was asked for a profile with no current, passing held-out evaluation — or none at all.
entries.action: Benchmark the profile and run a promotion evaluation first; the default is earned on evidence.

entries.name: no_plan_awaiting_decision
entries.cause: A plan decision was asked of an order with no plan standing undecided.
entries.action: Check the order's state — the plan may already be decided, or none drafted yet.

entries.name: no_promotion_history
entries.cause: A rollback was asked with no promotion events on record.
entries.action: Nothing to roll back to — the configured profile is the standing default.

entries.name: no_succeeded_run_to_return
entries.cause: Request-changes was asked of an order with no unaccepted SUCCEEDED run to send back.
entries.action: Request changes stands on a succeeded run; reject at review or re-plan instead.

entries.name: no_verified_run_awaiting_review
entries.cause: A review decision was asked of an order with no verified run awaiting it.
entries.action: Check the order's state — the run may have failed, or the review may already stand.

entries.name: partial_patch_not_reviewable
entries.cause: A review was asked of an abandoned run's partial patch.
entries.action: A partial patch is evidence for humans, never a submittable patch; run the work again to completion.

entries.name: plan_not_amendable
entries.cause: An amendment was asked of a plan that is not standing approved and unexecuted.
entries.action: Amendments stand on an approved, unexecuted plan; otherwise draft a new version.

entries.name: plan_not_approved
entries.cause: Execution was asked from a plan no human has approved.
entries.action: Have the plan approved at the plan gate first; the refusal is the gate working.

entries.name: plan_not_draftable
entries.cause: A plan draft was asked of an order whose state cannot take one.
entries.action: Drafting stands on draft, plan_rejected, or changes_requested — check the order's state.

entries.name: rebuttal_needs_evidence
entries.cause: A challenge rebuttal arrived without citing the record it answers from.
entries.action: Re-submit citing the stored record — a rebuttal is an argument from evidence, not an assertion.

entries.name: regression
entries.cause: A promotion candidate's worst held-out run regresses against the incumbent default's recorded baseline.
entries.action: The candidate does not promote; improve it and re-evaluate, measured the same way.

entries.name: resume_basis_changed
entries.cause: A resume's basis moved — the plan was superseded, the target drifted, or the workspace changed since the interruption.
entries.action: Restart the run under the same approval instead; the refusal names which basis moved.

entries.name: run_not_abandonable
entries.cause: An abandon was asked of a run that is not in an abandonable state.
entries.action: Check the run's state — terminal runs keep their records as they stand.

entries.name: run_not_interrupted
entries.cause: A resume was asked of a run that does not stand INTERRUPTED.
entries.action: Only an interrupted run resumes; a failed run restarts, a succeeded run reviews.

entries.name: run_not_restartable
entries.cause: A restart was asked of a run whose state cannot restart.
entries.action: Check the run's state and the order's approval — restart stands on the recorded approval.

entries.name: run_not_succeeded
entries.cause: An act reserved for SUCCEEDED runs was asked of a run in another state.
entries.action: Check the run's state; the act waits for a verified success.

entries.name: self_promotion
entries.cause: The promotion's actor is the evaluation's actor, compared by normalised name.
entries.action: Have a second person judge the promotion; separation of duties is the gate's point.

entries.name: template_already_published
entries.cause: A publish was asked of a template version that already stands published.
entries.action: Nothing to do — the version is usable as it stands.

entries.name: template_name_invalid
entries.cause: A template name failed the library's naming rules.
entries.action: Rename the template to the library's shape and create it again.

entries.name: template_not_published
entries.cause: An instantiation named a template version that has not been published.
entries.action: Have the version published by a second person first; drafts are readable, never usable.

entries.name: template_parameter_invalid
entries.cause: A template parameter value failed validation — a path parameter must be a single path segment; a prose parameter must be brace-free.
entries.action: Correct the value the refusal names; a value can never widen a template's scope.

entries.name: template_parameter_missing
entries.cause: An instantiation omitted a parameter the template declares.
entries.action: Supply every declared parameter; the refusal names the missing one.

entries.name: template_parameter_unknown
entries.cause: An instantiation supplied a parameter the template does not declare.
entries.action: Remove the unknown parameter; the declared set is exact in both directions.

entries.name: template_parameters_mismatch
entries.cause: A template's declared parameter set does not equal the set its patterns actually use.
entries.action: Fix the template so declaration and use agree, in both directions.

entries.name: template_scope_invalid
entries.cause: A template's substituted scope failed its re-check after substitution.
entries.action: Read the refusal for the offending entry; pattern and values were supplied separately and are checked together.

entries.name: template_scope_pattern_invalid
entries.cause: A template's scope pattern names an entry that is not a clean repo-relative path pattern.
entries.action: Fix the scope pattern; patterns are path shapes, not globs or traversals.

entries.name: template_scope_widening_refused
entries.cause: An instantiation restated a file scope wider than the template's substituted pattern.
entries.action: Instantiate with the template's own scope; a wider scope is a new template version's business.

entries.name: template_self_publish
entries.cause: A template's author tried to publish their own version.
entries.action: Have a second person publish it; separation of duties holds for the seed templates too.

entries.name: template_shape_invalid
entries.cause: A template's shape failed validation at creation.
entries.action: Read the refusal's message for the malformed part and create the version again.

entries.name: template_steps_invalid
entries.cause: A template's step skeleton failed validation — a step needs an intent and files inside the template's own scope pattern.
entries.action: Fix the skeleton; a skeleton may not teach a plan to reach outside its template's scope.

entries.name: unanswered_challenges
entries.cause: A review acceptance was asked while must-answer challenges stand unanswered on the run.
entries.action: Answer each challenge — revise, rebut from the records, or downgrade with a reason — then accept.

entries.name: unknown_batch
entries.cause: An act named a batch the shell has no record of.
entries.action: Check the batch id; nothing was created under it.

entries.name: unknown_benchmark_set
entries.cause: A benchmark or comparison named a task set that is not one of the recorded splits.
entries.action: Name a recorded set — tuning or held-out.

entries.name: unknown_challenge
entries.cause: An act named a challenge the shell has no record of.
entries.action: Check the challenge id against the order's challenge list.

entries.name: unknown_challenge_disposition
entries.cause: A challenge answer named a disposition kind the shell does not record.
entries.action: Answer with a recorded kind: accept_and_revise, rebut, or downgrade.

entries.name: unknown_gold_task
entries.cause: An act named a gold task the suite does not carry.
entries.action: Check the task id against the suite's index.

entries.name: unknown_plan_version
entries.cause: An act named a plan version the order does not carry.
entries.action: Check the version against the order's plan history.

entries.name: unknown_review_decision
entries.cause: A review submission named a decision the shell does not record.
entries.action: Decide with a recorded decision: accept, reject, or request_changes.

entries.name: unknown_run
entries.cause: An act named a run the shell has no record of.
entries.action: Check the run id against the order's runs.

entries.name: unknown_template
entries.cause: An act named a template the library has no record of.
entries.action: Check the template name against the library.

entries.name: unknown_template_version
entries.cause: An act named a template version that does not exist for the name.
entries.action: Check the version against the template's recorded versions.

entries.name: unknown_work_order
entries.cause: An act named a work order the shell has no record of.
entries.action: Check the work order id; nothing was created under it.

entries.name: dual_control_same_actor
entries.cause: Under a deployment profile that requires dual control, the second decision on a parked act came from the actor who recorded the first — one person's two decisions are not two decisions.
entries.action: Have a different actor record the second decision; the parked act names its first decider.

entries.name: dual_control_excluded_actor
entries.cause: The deciding actor created the object under decision — the work order's requester or plan approver for a review acceptance, the evaluation's recorder for a promotion, the promotion's own actor for its rollback — and dual control excludes the creator from deciding it.
entries.action: Route the decision to an actor who did not create the object; the refusal names the excluded role.

entries.name: dual_control_already_decided
entries.cause: A further decision was attempted on an act dual control already completed — an accepted order, or a promotion to the profile that already stands as the default.
entries.action: Read the act's recorded decisions; a completed act is closed, and a new act needs a new object — a new run, a different candidate.

entries.name: dual_control_pending_act
entries.cause: A promotion or rollback was attempted while a different promotion-gate act stands parked awaiting its second decision — the gate holds one open act at a time.
entries.action: Complete, reject, or withdraw the parked act first; the promotion state names it and its first decider.

entries.name: dual_control_no_parked_act
entries.cause: A withdraw or reject named a parked dual-control act, but none stands parked — the act was never parked, or it already completed, was rejected, or was withdrawn.
entries.action: Read the act's current standing — the review packet, the promotion state; there is nothing open to withdraw or reject.

entries.name: dual_control_not_the_decider
entries.cause: A parked dual-control decision was withdrawn by an actor other than the one who recorded it — a decision is its decider's to withdraw, and no one else's.
entries.action: Ask the first decider to withdraw it, or have a second actor complete or reject the act instead.

entries.name: unknown_skill
entries.cause: An act named a skill the library does not carry.
entries.action: Check the name against the library's index; authoring a skill is a file act — add its content and index entry, then reload.

entries.name: unknown_skill_version
entries.cause: An act named a version of a skill the library does not carry under that name.
entries.action: Check the version against the library's index; only carried versions can be evaluated, published, or mounted.

entries.name: skill_not_published
entries.cause: A mount or rollback named a skill version that does not stand published — never published, or published and since rolled back; only a published version mounts.
entries.action: Publish the version through the skill gate (an evaluation of its exact content, judged by a second actor), or mount a version that stands published.

entries.name: skill_already_published
entries.cause: A publish act named a skill version that already stands published.
entries.action: Read the version's standing; a revised text is a new version, published through the same gate.

entries.name: skill_self_publish
entries.cause: A skill's author tried to publish their own version.
entries.action: Have a second person publish it; separation of duties is the gate's point, and it holds for the seed skills too.

entries.name: skill_evaluator_publish
entries.cause: The actor recorded the evaluation a skill would be published on and tried to publish it themselves.
entries.action: Have someone who did not produce the evidence judge the publication.

entries.name: skill_rollback_unavailable
entries.cause: A rollback named a skill whose latest published version is its only published version — there is no previous published version to restore.
entries.action: Publish a further version first, or leave the standing version published; a rollback never leaves a skill unmountable.

entries.name: skill_content_drifted
entries.cause: The library's text for a skill version no longer hashes to the content hash an approved plan cites — the version's file changed after the plan was drafted, or the version left the library.
entries.action: Draft a fresh plan against the library as it stands; the new plan cites the text it will actually run with.
